newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak BSE remains illiquid, SAX firms slightly.
newsitem.headline: Slovak BSE remains illiquid, SAX firms slightly.

text.p: A slight increase in the average price of steel maker VSZ on Monday helped boost the Bratislava Stock Exchange's 16-share SAX index 0.21 points to 168.88.
VSZ, which closed unchanged at 640 crowns, saw its average price rise 0.3 percent. But its 132 shares that changed hands were the only trading on the BSE's listed floor.
Overall volume fell to 522,079 shares, from 1,915,310 shares traded on Friday, while turnover decreased to 254.13 million crowns, from 1.198 billion.
Brokers said that while the market remained highly illiquid, some issues appear to have hit a floor which might attract investors back over the medium-term perspective.
